model: Wang2020 DH5alpha-trained RBF SVR; CPU reproduction of published training procedure, not a pretrained checkpoint

model_info.training_composition: 83 first-round generated promoters and 5 random sequences
model_info.training_target: log2 of the numerical activity labels in seq_exp_94.txt
model_info.activity_units: Upstream training-table arbitrary units; no unit header; not RPU or physical transcription rates
model_info.encoding: 50 positions, T/C/G/A channels, float32, flattened to 200 features
model_info.cross_validation: 5-fold unshuffled KFold after seeded permutation; R2 on log2 labels; refit all 88 records
model_info.cv_score_warning: Hyperparameter-selection CV, not an independent test of these candidates
model_info.paper: Wang et al., Nucleic Acids Research 48:6403-6412 (2020), doi:10.1093/nar/gkaa325
model_info.paper_reported_test_split: 66 training/validation records, 22 test records; not the full-data refit used here
model_info.published_assay_context: DH5alpha, modified pFAB217/p15A, sfGFP, fixed B0030 5-prime UTR, LB plus kanamycin; final published methods

reference_info.sequence_provenance: Exact 5-prime to 3-prime sequence supplied by the user; DL10 in the supplied notebooks is pptb_fU
reference_info.tss_warning: Model-inferred framing, not an experimentally mapped DH5alpha TSS. Several alternative TSS configurations have similar framing energies. Only fully contained configurations are considered; no upstream or downstream flanks are invented.
reference_info.framing_method: Lowest total free energy among fully contained forward-strand Promoter Calculator configurations; tie broken by earlier TSS; used only to infer framing, not an SVR activity denominator
reference_info.framing_organism: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655
reference_info.framing_host_warning: Promoter Calculator MG1655-labelled in-vivo parameters have no DH5alpha-specific fit. This model selects a reference-core framing only; its initiation-rate units are not used for SVR normalization.
reference_info.value_type: Prediction from the same DH5alpha SVR and fitted model as the candidates; not a notebook fluorescence measurement
reference_info.normalization: Predicted linear candidate activity divided by predicted pptb_fU core activity; reference = 1.0 or 100 percent
reference_info.sensitivity_warning: Scenario range over the five lowest-energy reference TSS configurations, selected before SVR scoring; not a confidence interval or a maximum-SVR primary prediction

input_selection: First 10 canonical records in file order; no reverse-complementing or padding
tss_warning: Native inferred anchor, not an experimentally mapped DH5alpha TSS
output_transformation: activity = 2 ** predicted_log2_activity; fraction = activity / predicted_pptb_fU_core_activity; percent = 100 * fraction
interpretation: Conditional 50-bp-core reporter-activity estimates relative to the same-model predicted pptb_fU core; not measured fold-changes, whole-insert expression, validated RPU or probabilities; reference TSS uncertainty is material
